answer: Anchor each identity to a bonded deposit in a shared insurance pool, with co-liability following funding and vouch edges. If any identity is slashed, the loss is drawn first from the bonds of those linked to it along its vine of provenance. An honest agent, unlinked to bad actors, risks only its own stake. A farm minting a tide of fakes from one funder binds them into one liable cluster, so a single caught fake pulls slashing across every sibling bond it seeded — making cheap mass identity self-penalizing.
